group.label: TBC Bank (Flitt)
group.comment: Accept card payments via Flitt (TBC Bank): embedded card form in checkout or redirect to the Flitt payment page.

field.label: Title
field.comment: Payment method name shown to customers at checkout.

field.label: Payment Action
field.comment:
Authorize & Capture: the charge completes automatically the moment the order is placed — the invoice is created and paid.
Authorize Only: reserve the funds now and capture later, when you create the invoice (Invoice → Capture Online).
Both modes reserve first and charge second (two-stage card flow), so pre-authorization must be enabled on your Flitt merchant account — contact Flitt support if payments fail with "Preauth not allowed" (code 1027).

field.label: Merchant ID
field.comment: Merchant ID from your Flitt merchant portal.

field.label: Payment Secret Key
field.comment: Payment secret key from your Flitt merchant portal. Stored encrypted.

field.label: Order ID Prefix
field.comment: Short tag prepended to the order id sent to Flitt (e.g. shop1_000000123_1752480000). Set a different prefix per shop when several Magento instances share one Flitt merchant account; leave empty if this is the only shop on the account. Letters and digits only.

field.label: Checkout Type
field.comment:
Embedded Card Form: the card form renders inside your checkout page — the customer never leaves the site.
Redirect to Payment Page: the customer is redirected to the Flitt hosted payment page and returns after payment.

field.label: Google Pay (Embedded Form)
field.comment: Show the Google Pay button in the embedded card form. Google Pay payments are held and captured like card payments. Applies to the embedded form only; the rails offered on the redirect payment page are managed in the Flitt merchant portal.

field.label: Apple Pay (Embedded Form)
field.comment: Show the Apple Pay button in the embedded card form (Safari/Apple devices only). Requires domain verification first: request the apple-developer-merchantid-domain-association file from Flitt support, serve it at /.well-known/apple-developer-merchantid-domain-association on every (sub)domain, and ask Flitt to activate the domain with Apple.

field.label: Saved Cards
field.comment: Let logged-in customers save their card during payment and pay with it in one click next time. Cards are stored at Flitt as tokens (rectoken) — no card data touches this server. Requires token payments to be enabled on your Flitt merchant account — contact Flitt support if saved-card payments fail with code 1059/1060. Saved-card charges cannot use 3D Secure; banks that require it will decline, and the customer is asked to pay with the normal card form instead.

field.label: Saved Cards Title
field.comment: Name of the saved-cards payment option shown at checkout.

field.label: Allowed Currencies
field.comment: Order currencies accepted through Flitt — the method is hidden at checkout for orders in any other currency. Georgian merchants can process GEL, USD and EUR. Select at least one.

field.label: Order Lifetime (seconds)
field.comment: How long an unpaid Flitt order stays payable before it expires. Default: 36000 (10 hours).

field.label: Reconciler Grace (seconds)
field.comment: How long the cleanup cron waits before acting on an unfinished payment session (cancelling expired pending orders, reversing orphaned holds). Must comfortably exceed how long a customer might take to resume an interrupted checkout. Default: 3600 (1 hour).

field.label: Debug Logging
field.comment: Log full Flitt API request/response payloads to var/log/shubo_flitt.log. Request summaries and all errors are always logged there, regardless of this setting.
